description: THE EMPTY-ACCOUNT-ID REJECTION - stage one of PROCESS-ENTER-KEY, and the only path through app/cbl/COBIL00C.cbl that reaches that paragraph and touches no dataset whatsoever. Derived from app/cbl/COBIL00C.cbl:154-167 together with :289-301 and :319-338, and reached through :123-127. ACTIDINI OF COBIL0AI arrives as eleven SPACES, the first arm of the ordered EVALUATE TRUE at :158-159 matches on its SPACES disjunct, and the error flag it raises at :160 suppresses all three later stages of the paragraph. THE PRECONDITIONS, AND WHY THIS IS THE RE-ENTRY ARM. :107 finds EIBCALEN non-zero, so the cold-start arm at :108-109 is not taken and :111 copies the travelled area over CARDDEMO-COMMAREA. :112 IF NOT CDEMO-PGM-REENTER is FALSE because CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT arrives 1, so control takes the ELSE at :123: :124 performs RECEIVE-BILLPAY-SCREEN and the EVALUATE EIBAID at :125-142 matches WHEN DFHENTER at :126, which performs PROCESS-ENTER-KEY at :127. That is the REENTER side of gate G38; case01 and case03 carry the ENTER side and case06 carries the DFHPF4 arm of the same dispatch. IN SOURCE ORDER. :101-102 SET ERR-FLG-OFF TO TRUE and SET USR-MODIFIED-NO TO TRUE. :104-105 MOVE SPACES TO WS-MESSAGE and to ERRMSGO OF COBIL0AO, so the message field starts blank and the text below is the only thing that ever lands in it. :124 RECEIVE-BILLPAY-SCREEN at :306-314 captures RESP(WS-RESP-CD) and RESP2(WS-REAS-CD) and then NEVER TESTS EITHER - there is no EVALUATE WS-RESP-CD after it anywhere in the program - and that is preserved rather than tidied into a guard. :156 SET CONF-PAY-NO TO TRUE runs UNCONDITIONALLY at the very top of PROCESS-ENTER-KEY, before one byte of validation, which is why the confirmation flag is already 'N' when the rejection happens and not because of it. :158 EVALUATE TRUE. :159 WHEN ACTIDINI OF COBIL0AI = SPACES OR LOW-VALUES matches through the SPACES disjunct. :160 MOVE 'Y' TO WS-ERR-FLG. :161-162 MOVE 'Acct ID can NOT be empty...' TO WS-MESSAGE. :163 MOVE -1 TO ACTIDINL OF COBIL0AI, which positions the cursor and is an xxxL length item rather than a payload member, so it is declared as cursorField ACTIDINL. :164 PERFORM SEND-BILLPAY-SCREEN - EXACTLY ONE EMISSION, which is why sends carries one element and not two. :165-166 WHEN OTHER / CONTINUE is the second and last arm of the EVALUATE and is not taken; it is named here because an ordered EVALUATE's arm order is itself the expectation (gate G30) and because WHEN OTHER being last is what makes the SPACES arm reachable at all. WHAT DOES NOT HAPPEN, AND WHY NOTHING IS SEEDED. PROCESS-ENTER-KEY has four stages and the three after the EVALUATE each open with their OWN IF NOT ERR-FLG-ON - at :169, :197 and :208. They are not a cascade: each independently re-tests the flag, so raising it once at :160 suppresses the BODY of all three. Consequently :170-171 never move ACTIDINI into ACCT-ID and XREF-ACCT-ID; the EVALUATE CONFIRMI at :173-191 is never entered; :193-194 MOVE ACCT-CURR-BAL TO WS-CURR-BAL and MOVE WS-CURR-BAL TO CURBALI never run, which is the one thing that distinguishes this rejection from every other rejection in this program, all of which pass through :193-194 first; the nothing-to-pay guard at :198-205 never runs; and the whole payment block at :210-242 never runs. Every file operation this program owns is reached ONLY from those suppressed stages - READ-ACCTDAT-FILE at :343-372 from :177 and :184, READ-CXACAIX-FILE at :408-436 from :211, STARTBR/READPREV/ENDBR/WRITE-TRANSACT-FILE at :441-547 from :213-233, and UPDATE-ACCTDAT-FILE at :377-403 from :235 - so NO DATASET IS READ, NO DATASET IS WRITTEN AND NO DATASET IS EVEN OPENED. inputs, expectedWrites, expectedFinalState, expectedDatasets and normalisations are therefore all empty BY DERIVATION AND NOT BY OMISSION: seeding a row here would assert a read the COBOL does not make, and the case would stop being the zero-I/O case it exists to be. This is the same reasoning case01 states for the first-entry arm. THE MESSAGE, BYTE BY BYTE. The literal at :161 is 'Acct ID can NOT be empty...' - 27 characters, with NOT capitalised and THREE trailing full stops, exactly as the source spells it. It is not normalised to 'not', not shortened to a single ellipsis character and not trimmed. WS-MESSAGE is PIC X(80) [app/cbl/COBIL00C.cbl:39], so the MOVE left-justifies the 27 characters and space-pads to 80: the 80-byte working-storage image is the literal followed by 53 spaces. SEND-BILLPAY-SCREEN then does MOVE WS-MESSAGE TO ERRMSGO OF COBIL0AO at :293, and ERRMSGO is PIC X(78) [app/cpy-bms/COBIL00.CPY:78], so an alphanumeric move TRUNCATES ON THE RIGHT and the two discarded bytes are both spaces. The 78-byte screen image asserted below as ERRMSGO is therefore the literal followed by 51 spaces, counted rather than trimmed. The 80-byte and the 78-byte images are related but NOT equal, and both are stated here on purpose: the two lost bytes are the whole reason the parity contract keeps the WS-MESSAGE and ERRMSG channels apart. THE ONE SEND, AND EXACTLY WHICH ITEMS IT CLAIMS. This case declares unitKind SERVICE, so the unit is BillPaymentService.processEnterKey - the translation of PROCESS-ENTER-KEY from :154 onwards - and the send it records carries the FOUR items that paragraph and SEND-BILLPAY-SCREEN write themselves: ACTIDINO at its declared eleven characters, CURBALO at fourteen, CONFIRMO at one and ERRMSGO at seventy-eight, every width taken mechanically from the xxxI PICTURE clauses of app/cpy-bms/COBIL00.CPY, whose xxxO items redefine the same spans. THE HEADER SIX ARE NOT CLAIMED HERE, AND THAT IS DELIBERATE RATHER THAN AN OMISSION. SEND-BILLPAY-SCREEN performs POPULATE-HEADER-INFO at :291, and that paragraph at :319-338 is projected by the controller in this translation, not by the service, so a SERVICE case that named its fields would be asserting fields the unit under test cannot produce and the diff count could never reach zero. Their values are pinned by the CONTROLLER_POJO cases case01, case03 and case06, and they are written out in full here so this file states them rather than leaving them implicit: TRNNAMEO is WS-TRANID 'CB00' at four characters [:38, moved at :325]; PGMNAMEO is WS-PGMNAME 'COBIL00C' at eight [:37, moved at :326]; TITLE01O is CCDA-TITLE01 '      AWS Mainframe Modernization       ' at forty, six leading and seven trailing spaces [app/cpy/COTTL01Y.cpy:18-19, moved at :323]; TITLE02O is CCDA-TITLE02 '              CardDemo                  ' at forty, fourteen leading and eighteen trailing spaces [app/cpy/COTTL01Y.cpy:20-22, moved at :324]; CURDATEO is WS-CURDATE-MM-DD-YY, the eight-byte MM/DD/YY group of app/cpy/CSDAT01Y.cpy:30-35, which at the instant pinned below renders 07/19/22 [moved at :332]; and CURTIMEO is WS-CURTIME-HH-MM-SS, the eight-byte HH:MM:SS group of app/cpy/CSDAT01Y.cpy:36-41, which renders 23:12:32 [moved at :338]. Untrimmed in both titles, because a trimmed title is a different forty bytes. CURBALO IS FOURTEEN SPACES, AND THE REASON IS THE POINT OF THE CASE. CURBALI is referenced at exactly two sites in the whole program and both are WRITES - :194, which this path never reaches, and :564 inside INITIALIZE-ALL-FIELDS, which this arm never invokes. The program NEVER READS the field, so nothing about the balance can influence a decision here; app/bms/COBIL00.bms declares it ATTRB=(ASKIP,FSET,NORM) COLOR=BLUE LENGTH=14 POS=(11,32), a protected display field. Nothing is seeded into it, and it therefore goes back holding the fourteen spaces its working-storage item starts at, UNCHANGED. It is emphatically NOT blanked by INITIALIZE-ALL-FIELDS, which is not performed on this arm, and it is emphatically NOT populated with an edited balance, because :193-194 was never reached. Do not read the fourteen spaces as a cleared field or as a zero balance: they are an untouched field. CONFIRMO IS 'Y', AND THAT IS WHAT PROVES THE SUPPRESSION. The confirmation arrives as 'Y' and goes back as 'Y', unchanged, because the EVALUATE CONFIRMI at :173 is inside the :169 guard and is never reached. 'Y' is chosen rather than a space precisely because it is the value that WOULD have done the most: at :174-177 it sets CONF-PAY-YES and performs READ-ACCTDAT-FILE, and at :210-235 it reads the cross-reference, browses the master, writes a transaction and rewrites the account. None of that happens. A case that supplied a blank confirmation could not distinguish stage one having fired from stage two simply having nothing to do, so the value of CONFIRMI being irrelevant to the outcome is itself the assertion. NO ATTRIBUTE IS ASSERTED, AND NONE MAY BE INVENTED. The attributes map is empty and must stay empty. COBIL00C copies neither CSSETATY nor CSSTRPFY - its COPY list at :63-85 is COCOM01Y, COBIL00, COTTL01Y, CSDAT01Y, CSMSG01Y, CVACT01Y, CVACT03Y, CVTRA05Y, DFHAID and DFHBMSCA - and DFHRED appears nowhere in its 572 lines, so there is no red-and-asterisk highlight to expect. app/bms/COBIL00.bms already declares ERRMSG as ATTRB=(ASKIP,BRT,FSET) COLOR=RED LENGTH=78 POS=(23,1), so the error line is red by mapset definition and needs no move. The only attribute byte this program ever writes is the DFHGREEN of :526, on the transaction-WRITE success arm that this path never reaches. The only field-level emphasis the source performs here is the MOVE -1 TO ACTIDINL at :163, and because a cursor is an xxxL length item it is declared as cursorField and not smuggled into the payload. NO MONETARY FIELD IS COMPUTED ON THIS PATH, WHICH IS STATED RATHER THAN LEFT AS A SILENT ABSENCE because a reader who sees CURBALO might reasonably expect a balance behind it. The program's only COMPUTE is at :234, inside the payment block at :210-242 that the error flag suppresses, and the only ADD is the identifier increment at :217 in the same block. No BigDecimal, no scale and no RoundingMode is therefore asserted here, and the truncating arithmetic of COBIL00C belongs to the cases that reach :211-235. Nothing is rounded, so nothing needs RoundingMode.DOWN to be right. STATELESSNESS. EIBCALEN is 218: the 160 bytes app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy declares for CARDDEMO-COMMAREA plus the 58 bytes of the CDEMO-CB00-INFO group COBIL00C.cbl:64-72 appends in place. The one commarea item this path depends on is CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT, which :112 tests through the CDEMO-PGM-REENTER condition name, and it arrives 1 and LEAVES 1: PROCESS-ENTER-KEY neither reads another field of the area nor writes one, there is no XCTL on this path - the program's only transfer is the EXEC CICS XCTL PROGRAM(CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM) at :281-284 inside RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN, reached only from MAIN-PARA at :109 and :135 - and RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN, which is the only thing that would move ZEROS into CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT at :280, is not performed. Control falls to EXEC CICS RETURN TRANSID(WS-TRANID) COMMAREA(CARDDEMO-COMMAREA) at :146-149, so the termination is RETURN_TRANSID and the pseudo-conversation continues carrying the area in the payload. nextProgram, nextMapset and nextMap are all absent: no transfer happened, and :296-297 names the mapset and the map on the SEND, which is the controller's projection rather than the service's. All conversation state - the area, the AID and the screen values - travels in the payload, so no server-side session state exists or is implied (gate G37, AAP rule R6). RETURN CODE AND EMITTED LINES. expectedReturnCode is 0. COBIL00C never assigns RETURN-CODE - the identifier does not appear in its 572 lines - and it contains no CALL 'CEE3ABD', so there is no abend and no non-zero exit to express; the failure is signalled entirely by WS-ERR-FLG holding 'Y' and by the screen message. Zero is stated rather than defaulted so the expectation says so. expectedMessages is EMPTY, and that is derivation rather than omission too: the only lines this program emits are the DISPLAY 'RESP:' WS-RESP-CD 'REAS:' WS-REAS-CD statements on the WHEN OTHER arms at :366, :397, :430, :461, :490 and :541, every one of them inside a file-handling paragraph this path never enters. The 80-byte WS-MESSAGE image and its 78-byte truncation are pinned in prose above and as ERRMSGO below rather than repeated on a second channel, because screen text belongs to the send that produced it. PROVENANCE. Every value in this case is STATICALLY DERIVED - read out of the COBOL paragraph that produces it and cross-checked against the xxxI PICTURE clauses of app/cpy-bms/COBIL00.CPY, the DFHMDF definitions of app/bms/COBIL00.bms, the X(40) VALUE literals of app/cpy/COTTL01Y.cpy, the eight-byte MM/DD/YY and HH:MM:SS groups of app/cpy/CSDAT01Y.cpy and the 160-byte layout of app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy - and it WAS NOT CAPTURED FROM A LIVE COBOL EXECUTION, not one byte of it. Such a capture is empirically impossible in this environment: there is no z/OS or CICS runtime, the available compiler reports its indexed file handler as disabled, there are no Language Environment CEE services, and DFHAID, DFHBMSCA and DFHATTR are absent from the repository. AAP 0.7.6 documents eight independently verified blockers and 0.9.11 records the substitution as risk R-A, escalated for confirmation rather than absorbed. DETERMINISM. The clock is pinned to 2022-07-19T23:12:32, the instant every case in this directory pins and the date the CardDemo_v1.0-15-g27d6c6f-68 version footer at COBIL00C.cbl:571 carries, so the header renders 07/19/22 and 23:12:32 rather than whatever the wall clock said. It is read through an injected Clock by way of common/DateHeader and never from a captured now. Two-digit month, day and hour, well clear of midnight and of any daylight-saving edge, so neither rendering is ambiguous. The charset is named explicitly as US-ASCII rather than left to a platform default, which for a nine-fixture ASCII corpus and a twelve-dataset EBCDIC one is the difference between a comparison and a coincidence. UNIT KIND. PROCESS-ENTER-KEY is the paragraph under test and the migration puts it in BillPaymentService.processEnterKey, which is why this case declares SERVICE and names that class. The service is constructed through its own constructor with stubbed collaborators and its method is called directly: no HTTP, no MockMvc, no TestRestTemplate, no WebTestClient, no servlet container, no JobLauncher and no application context anywhere in the path, which is what gate G51 asks for. jobParameters is empty because a job parameter comes from a JCL PARM and this is an online invocation; COBIL00C has no JCL at all. The gates this case carries are G15, G18 with a diff count of zero, G30 for the arm order of the EVALUATE TRUE at :158-167 with WHEN OTHER last, G37, G38 on its REENTER side and G51. G16, G19, G21, G23, G24, G28, G32, G35, G39, G40, G45 and G47 do not apply, and their inapplicability is the case: no I/O, no arithmetic, no GO TO, no abend, no pagination and no XCTL.
